raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

AITER can write the MXFP4 MoE stage-2 `scatter` partials as FP4 instead of BF16 (`AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE=1`). GLM-5.3-Flash uses `scatter` for its 16384-token bucket, so long-prompt prefill benefits. The switch is lossy and process-wide in AITER, so this keeps it opt-in and honors it only for GLM-5.3-Flash on ROCm.

## Modifications

- Register `AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE` in `Envs`, default off.
- During model-specific resolution, clear it with a warning unless the launch is `Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration` on ROCm.

Enable with:

```bash
AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE=1
```

Depends on #47139, which moves the AITER pin to include [ROCm/aiter#6435](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6435).

## Accuracy Tests

Focused validation passed **2 CPU unit tests**: kept for GLM-5.3-Flash on ROCm; cleared for another architecture, a non-ROCm platform, and no architecture.

Full GLM-5.3-Flash TP8 GSM8K on `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4` snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`: 1,319 examples, 1,200 evaluator threads, 4,096 maximum output tokens, thinking enabled, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, sampling seed unset.

| Configuration | Score | Stop rate | Truncated rate | Error rate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| MXFP4 scatter intermediate — `AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE=1` | 97.35% | 99.70% | 0.30% | 0.00% |

TP4 GSM8K never reaches the 16384-token bucket, so TP4 was checked with RULER2 at 32,768 tokens (99% of prefill batches on the FP4 path): 12 subtasks × 100 samples, thinking off, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, source `bb1a9c3718`.

| Configuration | Score | Truncated rate | Error rate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| BF16 scatter intermediate — variable unset | 93.36% | 0.00% | 0.00% |
| MXFP4 scatter intermediate — `AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE=1` | 93.21% | 0.00% | 0.00% |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Environment:

- Hardware: AMD Instinct MI355X (`gfx950`)
- Docker image: `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261019`
- Model: `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`, snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`
- AITER: image AITER `2bb549102` plus the ROCm/aiter#6435 GLM-5.3-Flash MXFP4 MoE configs
- Validated source SHA: `f320188a6a`

### MoE stage latency

AITER `gemm_moe_tune.py --run_config`, 16384-token `scatter` rows, AITER `41d4d8d7e`, two alternating rounds.

| TP | Inter dim / experts / top-k | BF16 scatter (µs) | MXFP4 scatter (µs) | Delta |
| ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 512 / 288 / 8 | 984.95 | 861.00 | **-12.58%** |
| 4 | 512 / 289 / 9 | 1082.65 | 966.00 | **-10.77%** |
| 8 | 256 / 288 / 8 | 787.05 | 647.85 | **-17.69%** |
| 8 | 256 / 289 / 9 | 878.05 | 759.70 | **-13.48%** |

### End-to-end serving

GLM-5.3-Flash TP4, random 8K input / 1K output. The first concurrency-4 run in each repetition is the warmup; the tables average the two measured runs per concurrency. Both arms use the same source and differ only by `AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE`.

A. BF16 scatter intermediate — variable unset:

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | ITL (ms) | E2EL (ms) | Output tok/s |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 578.88 | 6.115 | 6932.34 | 590.64 |
| 8 | 886.97 | 6.830 | 8278.50 | 988.26 |
| 16 | 1499.84 | 7.995 | 10717.11 | 1528.80 |
| 32 | 2722.52 | 9.495 | 14659.20 | 2233.05 |
| 64 | 5178.95 | 11.745 | 21884.28 | 2994.08 |

B. MXFP4 scatter intermediate — `AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE=1` (delta versus BF16 scatter intermediate):

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | Delta | ITL (ms) | Delta | E2EL (ms) | Delta | Output tok/s | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 575.02 | -0.67% | 6.120 | +0.08% | 6934.92 | +0.04% | 590.41 | -0.04% |
| 8 | 877.01 | -1.12% | 6.840 | +0.15% | 8269.10 | -0.11% | 989.87 | +0.16% |
| 16 | 1478.56 | -1.42% | 8.005 | +0.13% | 10684.35 | -0.31% | 1532.84 | +0.26% |
| 32 | 2682.36 | -1.47% | 9.505 | +0.11% | 14588.42 | -0.48% | 2242.76 | +0.44% |
| 64 | 5096.40 | -1.59% | 11.745 | +0.00% | 21733.98 | -0.69% | 3015.61 | +0.72% |

TP4 TTFT improves by **0.67-1.59%** and output throughput by up to 0.72%; ITL is unchanged.

### TP8 end-to-end serving

GLM-5.3-Flash TP8, 131,072 context, random 8K input / 1K output. The first concurrency-4 run in each repetition is the warmup; the tables average the two measured runs per concurrency. Both arms use source `f320188a6a` and differ only by `AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE`.

A. BF16 scatter intermediate — variable unset:

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | ITL (ms) | E2EL (ms) | Output tok/s |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 477.04 | 5.585 | 6239.92 | 656.20 |
| 8 | 725.18 | 6.100 | 7267.28 | 1125.78 |
| 16 | 1215.58 | 6.670 | 8836.62 | 1851.08 |
| 32 | 2195.26 | 7.710 | 11839.52 | 2763.88 |
| 64 | 4154.73 | 9.085 | 17180.88 | 3811.03 |

B. MXFP4 scatter intermediate — `AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE=1` (delta versus BF16 scatter intermediate):

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | Delta | ITL (ms) | Delta | E2EL (ms) | Delta | Output tok/s | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 468.73 | -1.74% | 5.590 | +0.09% | 6240.24 | +0.01% | 656.15 | -0.01% |
| 8 | 709.01 | -2.23% | 6.100 | +0.00% | 7243.09 | -0.33% | 1129.73 | +0.35% |
| 16 | 1186.46 | -2.39% | 6.660 | -0.15% | 8784.40 | -0.59% | 1863.26 | +0.66% |
| 32 | 2142.05 | -2.42% | 7.715 | +0.06% | 11747.90 | -0.77% | 2785.53 | +0.78% |
| 64 | 4057.34 | -2.34% | 9.090 | +0.06% | 17003.97 | -1.03% | 3852.67 | +1.09% |

TP8 TTFT improves by **1.74-2.42%** and output throughput by up to 1.09%; ITL is unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -5494,5 +5495,31 @@ def test_rust_response_without_provenance_rejected(self) -> None:

+class TestAiterMxfp4IntermediateGuard(CustomTestCase):
+    GLM = "Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration"
+
+    def _resolve(self, value, *, is_hip, model_arch):
+        flag = envs.AITER_MXFP4_INTERMEDIATE
+        with flag.override(value), override_platform(is_hip=is_hip):
+            _restrict_aiter_mxfp4_intermediate(model_arch)
+            return os.environ.get(flag.name)
+
+    def test_kept_only_for_glm53_flash_on_rocm(self):

+        # AITER reads the raw variable process-wide, so every other launch must

+        for is_hip, model_arch in (

+            (False, self.GLM),
+            (True, None),

+            with self.subTest(is_hip=is_hip, model_arch=model_arch):

+                )
